raw.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
raw.description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

RevenueCat helps apps of all shapes and sizes make more money across mobile, the web, and a growing list of other platforms like Roku, Amazon, and even AR through support for Vision Pro. As a result, many different types of users log in and use RevenueCat on a day-to-day basis. Product managers, support reps, lifecycle marketers, user acquisition specialists, data analysts, executives: the list goes on.

Communicating the growing breadth of use cases supported by RevenueCat in a way that makes sense for all those different types of businesses, apps, and users is a challenge. And that’s where product marketing comes in.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our growing Product Marketing team led by Francie. Each Senior PMM owns a product area end-to-end, partnering with that area's product managers on positioning, messaging, and go-to-market. This is not a segment-specific role: RevenueCat serves everyone from solo indie developers to top-tier enterprise apps, often through the very same product surface, so you'll craft messaging and channels that flex across that full spectrum. This role is perfect for someone who:

  • Knows APIs and SDKs like their ABCs. Code may not be your craft, but you know how to talk the talk. Software developers are one of our core audiences, and they can smell BS a mile away. You can debug marketing messaging so it resonates with technical audiences, and craft narratives around the 1’s and 0’s that still land with business stakeholders.

  • Captains their own ship. You have a strong bias toward action and you’re not afraid to get your hands dirty on execution. Whether it’s juggling strategic and tactical work or navigating shifting priorities, you thrive on autonomy and love making things happen.

  • Distills collaborative chaos. You’re comfortable raising your hand and getting what you need from a dynamic and technical organization. Whether it’s nudging engineers for product updates or rallying Sales for customer stories, you can navigate the chaos and advocate for what the GTM org needs.

  • Gets excited about the unexpected. At RevenueCat we take shipping seriously, and are constantly adapting our product and strategies to meet the needs of developers. You see changes in direction and shifts in strategy as an opportunity to flex your creative muscles and learn on the fly.

  • Is a little quirky. You love a whimsical side quest and you can see the soft side of software. We pride ourselves in keeping our community on their toes with unique swag, challenges and events. You can play as big a role as you’d like in helping to brainstorm and bring these quirky concepts to life.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • GTM and adoption campaigns: Own key product areas to deeply understand the features we’re launching and the use cases and needs behind them. Craft compelling communication plans both within the organization, and to existing and prospective customers.

  • Lifecycle campaign building: Working with our marketing operations team to execute insight-based lifecycle campaigns to drive adoption, retention and community.

  • Web page design and optimization: Translate product messaging and customer understanding into visually compelling and highly converting web experiences with the help of our external web development agency. You’ll chart the vision for the story our website tells and the illustrations, animations and tools we create to convey it.

  • Case studies and testimonials: Organizing, facilitating, and translating customer interviews into compelling case studies and testimonials that showcase the value of RevenueCat.

  • Internal enablement: As an expert in your areas of product focus, you’ll empower developer-facing teams with the resources and training they need to support developers and ensure their success.

  • Market insights: Keeping your finger on the pulse of the mobile app industry and competitors to inform go-to-market strategies and uncover new opportunities for growth.

  • Whimsical side quests: Taking on unique projects with minimal instruction, coordinating the collection of 1000 screenshots to launch Paywalls.com, designing, printing and shipping a calendar of cat photos, hosting the World Paywall Speed Building Championships, or crafting a keynote speech for leadership. You’ll get to work on projects that stretch your creative muscles.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing within a B2B or B2D SaaS environment, preferably targeting developers or software companies. RevenueCat runs a hybrid motion - self-serve/PLG for indie developers alongside a sales-assisted motion for larger accounts - so experience with either end of that spectrum is valuable; you won't need to have done both to succeed here.

  • Previous experience as a solo-marketer is preferred. While you’ll have the broader marketing and product marketing teams to lean on, our async, entrepreneurial culture is best suited to someone who is comfortable independently driving projects forward, making progress amid changing processes, and actively enlisting cross-functional support when needed.

  • Experience owning end-to-end go-to-market efforts, including tier 1 product launches. Strong project management skills to prioritize multiple initiatives and execute effectively across teams.

  • Strong creative instincts and direction. You’ve led the charge on web design work and aren’t afraid to sketch, prototype in Figma, or use AI tools to get to an ugly starting point. Comfortable collaborating with external creative agencies and freelancers to deliver high-quality assets.

  • Excellent editorial judgment: you understand audience, tone, and communication objectives, and you can elevate copy through clear direction and feedback. You will not need to write everything yourself, but you’re comfortable jumping in to draft a narrative outline or even a blog post when necessary, and you know when to pass work forward to the content team or a technical writer

  • Exceptional communication skills to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams, ensuring alignment and buy-in from key stakeholders.

  • A proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling messaging that resonates with different audiences, both internally and externally.

  • The resourcefulness to take on unique, sometimes ambiguous projects that require initiative and problem-solving.

Ideally you:

  • Have experience in the mobile app ecosystem or working with subscription-based software products.

  • Have worked in an early-stage tech company or led new initiatives independently in a larger organization.

  • Have experience working as a solo marketer or solo PMM within an organization.

  • Are comfortable with tools like Notion, Slack, Zoom, and Linear for remote collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first month, you’ll:

  • Gain hands-on experience with the RevenueCat platform, supported by our engineers and advocates.

  • Build a foundational understanding of the app ecosystem, particularly around monetization.

  • Establish relationships with key collaborators across Product, Sales, and Marketing.

  • Deliver your “first ship,” a project that demonstrates your insights and adds real value to the team.

Within the first 3 months, you’ll:

  • Step into the role as the go-to-market owner for your specific product areas, becoming an expert on relevant features, their roadmap and related market segments.

  • Own the go-to-market efforts for product areas, leading cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of awareness and adoption efforts.

  • Craft and distribute internal enablement materials and training related to your product areas.

  • Publish a new landing page, leading the concept, briefing, design and written copy process, with execution by our web agency.

  • Conduct customer research to deepen your understanding of our audience’s challenges and goals, and publish a customer case study.

Within the first 6 months, you’ll:

  • Own and optimize the self-serve adoption funnel for your product areas, partnering with Growth and Product and leveraging lifecycle marketing to turn feature interest into activation and long-term retention.

  • Level up your product area’s sales motion by revamping core pitch materials, competitive positioning, and objection handling.

  • Partner with Product to translate customer and market insights into clear roadmap recommendations.

  • Contribute to a whimsical side quest that adds to our brand and community.

After 12 months, you’ll:

  • Be a trusted partner across Product, Sales, and Marketing, contributing strategically to RevenueCat’s growth.

  • Have led multiple successful product launches, including a tier 1 launch, and owned key marketing initiatives.

  • Represent RevenueCat at industry events and conferences

  • Deepen your knowledge of app development and monetization, becoming an expert in the space.

What we offer:

  • Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

  • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

  • A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

  • 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

  • Paid desk at a co-working space

  • Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat, including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work:

  • The values that guide how we work: Our Values

  • How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat

  • What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations

  • What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

title: Senior Software Engineer - Product Builder
description: Chez Seyna, notre mission est simple: permettre aux professionnels de l'assurance de protéger ceux qui voient grand. Rejoins notre mission ! 🚀 Seyna est un assureur qui apporte une efficacité incomparable aux courtiers. Grâce à sa technologie et à la réactivité de ses équipes, Seyna accompagne les courtiers à chaque étape de leur développement : création du produit d'assurance sur-mesure, outils de vente et de gestion, analyse et amélioration du produit d'assurance, conformité. Depuis son lancement en 2019, date à laquelle Seyna a obtenu son agrément ACPR d'assureur, Seyna a convaincu plus de 100 courtiers, dont SPVIE, Verspieren, WTW, Garantme, APRIL, Marsh ou encore Dalma. Ils utilisent Seyna pour protéger près de deux millions d'assurés dans 6 pays européens. Grâce à un investissement de 57 millions d'euros de la part de GFC, WhiteStar Capital, Elaia et 115K (La Banque Postale) Seyna a des ambitions mondiales pour améliorer le secteur de l'assurance en modernisant la conception et la gestion des programmes d'assurance. TA FUTURE ÉQUIPE : L'équipe Product & Engineering, c'est le cerveau technologique de Seyna : elle construit la plateforme qui fait tourner Seyna et ses courtiers, du travail de discovery jusqu'à la mise en production, en sprints de 2 semaines. En tant que Software Product Engineer, tu rejoins l'équipe Tech avec un rôle unique, embarqué au plus près des équipes métier (actuariat, juridique, comptabilité…), en reportant directement à Guillaume, notre CPTO. Ta mission : construire avec l'IA les outils qui vont démultiplier la productivité de toute l'entreprise ! CE QUE TU FERAS : Immersion métier : Plonger dans l'équipe que tu outilles et pratiquer réellement son métier, pour comprendre de l'intérieur ses processus, ses contraintes réglementaires et ses irritants du quotidien. Discovery & priorisation : Mener la recherche utilisateur (interviews, observation, analyse des process), identifier les problèmes à plus fort impact et piloter seul ton backlog selon la valeur business attendue. Specs & architecture : Traduire les besoins en specs concises et en décisions d'architecture documentées, pour que chaque choix soit tracé et facilement repris par l'équipe Tech. Delivery de bout en bout : Développer, tester et mettre en production toi-même tes solutions, avec un vrai niveau de qualité production (code review, tests, monitoring, documentation). Livrer vite, sans créer de dette ! L'IA au cœur du build : Utiliser les agents de code (Claude Code…) comme levier de vélocité, et intégrer l'IA directement dans les outils que tu construis : automatisation, extraction, génération, agents métier. Mesure & itération : Définir des critères de succès avec le métier, mesurer l'adoption et l'impact de tes outils, et itérer rapidement à partir des données et des retours utilisateurs. Alignement & diffusion : Réutiliser les briques existantes de la plateforme Seyna avec les équipes Product & Engineering, faire remonter ce qui mérite d'être industrialisé et partager tes méthodes de build augmenté par l'IA pour faire monter toute l'organisation en niveau. TU ES AU BON ENDROIT SI : Tu maîtrises le développement full-stack en TypeScript (React, Node.js) sur AWS et GitHub, et tu livres du code de qualité production. Tu as une vraie rigueur d'ingénierie : architecture réfléchie, tests, code review, monitoring et documentation font partie de ton ADN. Tu es AI-native : les agents de code font partie de ton quotidien, et tu sais intégrer l'IA dans des produits utiles. Tu sais mener une discovery : interviewer, observer, et formuler clairement le vrai problème avant d'écrire la moindre ligne de code. Tu apprends vite et tu adores plonger dans un métier qui n'est pas le tien. Tu es orienté(e) impact : tu mesures ce que tu livres et tu t'appuies sur la data pour décider de la suite. Tu aimes résoudre des problèmes complexes et tu sais embarquer des profils tech comme non-tech, sans autorité hiérarchique. ✨ Bonus si tu as déjà rédigé des specs et arbitré un backlog dans un rôle de Product Manager. CE QUE SEYNA TE PROPOSE : 💵 Rémunération : Un package compétitif avec des BSPCE pour que vous puissiez partager le succès à mesure que nous grandissons. 🏖 Congés payés : 7 à 10 jours de RTT (selon le nombre de jours ouvrés dans l'année) en plus de vos 28 jours de congés payés. 🍜 Ticket restaurant : Une carte ticket restaurant Benefiz prise en charge à 60% par Seyna (10€/jour). 🚇 Transport en commun : 50% de votre moyen de transport préféré (Navigo, vélo, train) pris en charge par Seyna. 🚑 Assurance santé : Mutuelle Generali prise en charge à 95% par Seyna 🏄 Événements d'équipe : Un séminaire annuel pour profiter de moments tous ensemble. 🧡 Une équipe positive avec qui travailler au quotidien et une opportunité excitante de rejoindre une insurtech à forte ambition (FT120) ! NOTRE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT : En moyenne, notre processus de recrutement dure 2 à 3 semaines ! Voici plus de détail ci-dessous : Un 1er échange avec Gianni (Talent Acquisition Manager) - 45' → Tu pourras mieux comprendre le rôle, les missions et ce qu'on attend pour ce poste. Un Hiring Manager Interview avec Guillaume (CPTO) - 45' → Cela te permettra d'entrer dans le détail du poste : les missions au quotidien, les défis et les attentes liées au rôle. Un Skills-based Assessment avec Kseniia (Engineering Manager) et Maxime (Senior Staff Engineer) - 60' → Le case te donne l'occasion de montrer concrètement tes compétences et ton savoir-faire en lien avec le job. Un Seynalma Interview avec Charlotte (Client Performance Director) et Anne-Céline (Senior CSM) - 2x45' → Cela te permettra de voir si notre culture d'entreprise colle avec tes valeurs et ta façon de travailler. Un Final Interview avec Stephen (CEO) - 30' → C'est le moment d'échanger avec notre CEO et de voir si tes drivers matchent avec nos 3 Unique Selling Propositions pour les Talents !   • Vous serez les premiers informés lorsqu'un poste s'ouvre.

title: Sales Development Representative - CDI
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Notre mission Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation. ⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation . Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement” 👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 ! 💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux ! Le mot de la CEO “Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs. Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon Et ce poste alors ? Le rôle En première ligne de notre développement commercial , tu travailleras main dans la main avec le Sales Manager et les Account Executives au sein d'une équipe outillée et ambitieuse, sur un cycle de vente court. Missions et responsabilités Prospection intensive et ciblée (Outbound) : Identifier et qualifier des comptes clés dans le secteur de l'installation solaire. Tu contacteras les prospects via une approche multicanale avec une majorité de Cold Calling (notre cible d'artisans est très réceptive au téléphone), du Cold Emailing et LinkedIn. Qualification des leads (Inbound & Outbound) : Traiter rapidement les demandes entrantes générées par le marketing. Tu devras qualifier les besoins lors des premiers appels de découverte et transformer l'intérêt en rendez-vous de démonstration qualifié pour l'équipe de closing. Rigueur opérationnelle et Data : Assurer une tenue irréprochable de notre CRM (HubSpot) via la mise à jour des statuts, la prise de notes et le log des appels. Tu utiliseras notre stack et suivras tes KPIs quotidiens et hebdomadaires. Amélioration continue : Remonter les objections fréquentes et les retours du terrain au VP Sales et au Marketing pour affiner le discours. Tu participeras activement aux sessions de coaching et de partage de bonnes pratiques de l'équipe. Tes objectifs: ⭐ 0 à 1 mois : L'onboarding et les premiers pas Acquérir une compréhension parfaite du produit Solteo, de la proposition de valeur et du marché cible. Prendre en main la stack technique (HubSpot, Aircall, Apollo) et lancer tes premières séquences de prospection et appels à froid pour générer tes premiers SQL. 🎯 Objectif : Maîtrise du pitch commercial, des outils de prospection et autonomie dans la génération de rendez-vous. ⭐ 1 à 8 mois : L'exécution et la machine à leads Exécuter les séquences avec régularité et intensité. Atteindre et dépasser tes quotas de rendez-vous bookés. Devenir une machine de qualification tout en encaissant les refus sans perdre ta motivation. 🎯 Objectif : Alimenter continuellement les agendas des Account Executives avec des leads ultra-qualifiés. ⭐ À partir de 8 mois : Les premières démos (Closing) C'est la concrétisation de ta montée en compétences ! Tu ne fais plus que prospecter : tu commences à prendre le relais sur la suite du cycle de vente en réalisant tes premières démonstrations produit auprès des prospects que tu as qualifiés. 🎯 Objectif : Maîtriser l'exercice de la démo et initier ta transition vers le closing. ⭐ >1 an : L'évolution Participer à l'amélioration des process de prospection et transmettre ton savoir aux nouveaux arrivants. 🎯 Objectif : Évoluer officiellement vers un poste d'Account Executive (Closer) à temps plein ou prendre des responsabilités managériales au sein de l'équipe SDR. Les compétences qu’on recherche Formation : Tu as une expérience dans la vente SaaS B2B ! Mindset : Tu as un mindset d'entrepreneur, tu aimes relever des challenges et mettre la main à la pâte. Humilité et capacité à se remettre en question : Forte envie de progresser et de prendre des responsabilités. Langues : Français et Anglais parfaitement bilingues/fluents. Ce qui serait un plus Une expérience dans la Construction Tech ou l' Energy Tech , ou auprès des artisans et du bâtiment. Une réelle motivation pour les projets à impact et la transition énergétique. Mais Solteo c’est aussi… Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée. La chance de parfaire et d'enrichir tes connaissances dans un secteur en pleine croissance et qui a du sens. Des bureaux situés en plein centre de Paris, avec plusieurs autres start-ups du solaire Une diversité de projets captivants, offrant l'opportunité de collaborer avec des clients diverses et variés. Pas possible de s’ennuyer ! Nous te promettons aussi une ambiance d’équipe bienveillante, accueillante et stimulante . Et bien sûr, plein d’évènements d’équipe ! Processus de recrutement 📞 Entretien de cadrage avec une recruteuse (30 min) : pour discuter de ton CV et des attentes sur le poste. 🤝 Entretien de fit en visio (45 min) : pour faire connaissance, discuter de ton parcours et de tes motivations avec Manon (CEO). 🎯 Entretien technique avec l’équipe commerciale (1h00) : mise en situation pratique sur un business case . 🕵️‍♂️ Prise de références (Réf call). 🍽️ Déjeuner d’équipe : rencontre conviviale avec les fondateurs et toute l'équipe Solteo. Détails du poste CDI - temps Plein Paris 17e Prise de poste: dès que possible Rémunération : 32-45K€ Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Notre mission

 

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation. Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement”

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux !

 

Le mot du CTO

"Quand j’ai rejoint Alexandre et Manon pour créer Solteo, je cherchais un projet qui mettrait mes compétences tech au service de la transition énergétique et où je pourrais voir directement l’impact de mon travail sur le quotidien de nos utilisateurs. Depuis le début, on développe notre produit dans cette optique : avec une attention toute particulière aux feedbacks de nos installateurs. C’est ultra motivant de recevoir leurs retours et de constater concrètement comment on améliore leur quotidien ! En tout cas, si tu veux t’épanouir techniquement, avoir un impact visible et direct sur les utilisateurs de ton produit, et contribuer à un projet porteur de sens, tu as frappé à la bonne porte !" — Kévin

 

Et ce poste alors ?

 

Le rôle

Chez Solteo, on veut continuer à accélérer le développement de notre produit sans que chaque sujet complexe repose sur le CTO.

On cherche donc un·e Senior Software Engineer Full-stack capable de prendre en charge des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu’à leur mise en production.

Tu travailleras en lien direct avec l’équipe produit, les autres développeurs, notre Tech Lead et le CTO. Ton rôle sera de transformer les besoins de nos utilisateurs en fonctionnalités utiles, fiables et simples à maintenir.

 

Missions et responsabilités

Tu prendras en charge le développement de fonctionnalités complètes, aussi bien côté frontend que backend.

Concrètement, tu participeras à la compréhension du besoin, au cadrage de la solution, au développement, aux tests, à la mise en production et au suivi de la fonctionnalité une fois livrée.

Tu auras de l’autonomie sur tes sujets, tout en pouvant t’appuyer sur le reste de l’équipe pour échanger, challenger les choix techniques et avancer sur les décisions les plus structurantes.

Ce que tu feras au quotidien

  • Concevoir et développer des fonctionnalités de bout en bout sur l’ensemble de notre stack.

  • Travailler avec l’équipe produit pour clarifier les besoins, identifier les cas limites et découper les sujets.

  • Écrire du code testé, lisible et maintenable, puis suivre les fonctionnalités après leur mise en production.

  • Participer aux revues de code et partager tes connaissances avec le reste de l’équipe.

  • Proposer des améliorations pertinentes sur notre code, nos outils et nos pratiques.


Notre stack technique :

  • Frontend web : React

  • Backend : Node.js, TypeScript, tRPC

  • Base de données : PostgreSQL

  • Application mobile : React Native

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Docker

  • CI/CD : GitHub Actions

  • Monitoring : Datadog

 

Tes objectifs:

⭐ Après 3 mois
Avoir livré 2 à 4 évolutions produit, dont au moins une fonctionnalité full-stack de bout en bout.

  • Être autonome sur les sujets de complexité intermédiaire, avec un accompagnement ponctuel.

  • Contribuer régulièrement aux revues de code et respecter les standards de qualité de l’équipe.

🎯 Objectif : être opérationnel·le sur notre stack et capable de livrer de manière autonome des fonctionnalités de complexité intermédiaire.

⭐ Après 6 mois
Avoir mené au moins 2 fonctionnalités complexes, de leur cadrage jusqu’à leur suivi en production.

  • Être autonome sur les décisions techniques courantes liées à tes sujets.

  • Avoir réalisé au moins une amélioration mesurable sur la qualité, la performance ou l’efficacité de l’équipe.

🎯 Objectif : être autonome sur les fonctionnalités complexes et contribuer concrètement à l’amélioration du produit et des pratiques de l’équipe.

⭐ Au-delà d'un an
Avoir mené 3 à 5 projets produit complexes depuis ton arrivée.

  • Être référent·e sur au moins un domaine fonctionnel ou technique du produit.

  • Contribuer régulièrement à l’amélioration des pratiques et au partage de connaissances dans l’équipe.

🎯 Objectif : être une personne de confiance pour mener les sujets produit importants et faire progresser durablement l’équipe.

 

Les compétences qu’on recherche

 

  • Tu maîtrises TypeScript, React et Node.js.

  • Tu as déjà livré des fonctionnalités full-stack sur un produit utilisé en production.

  • Tu as une solide expérience avec une base de données relationnelle, idéalement PostgreSQL.

  • Tu sais concevoir une fonctionnalité de bout en bout : interface, backend, données, tests et mise en production.

  • Tu es autonome pour cadrer, découper et mener des sujets complexes.

 

Ce qui serait un plus

  • Tu as déjà travaillé avec tRPC.

  • Tu as une expérience avec React Native.

  • Tu connais AWS, Docker ou GitHub Actions.

  • Tu as déjà évolué dans un SaaS B2B ou une petite équipe produit.

  • Le secteur de l’énergie et la transition écologique t’intéressent.

 

Mais Solteo c’est aussi…

  • Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée.

  • La chance de parfaire et d'enrichir tes connaissances dans un secteur en pleine croissance et qui a du sens.

  • Des bureaux situés en plein centre de Paris, avec plusieurs autres start-ups du solaire

  • Une diversité de projets captivants, offrant l'opportunité de collaborer avec des clients diverses et variés. Pas possible de s’ennuyer !

Nous te promettons aussi une ambiance d’équipe bienveillante, accueillante et stimulante. Et bien sûr, plein d’évènements d’équipe !

raw.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

 

Notre mission

 

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation. Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement”

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux !

 

Le mot de la CEO

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon

Et ce poste alors ?

 

Le rôle

Nous recherchons notre Founding Marketing Manager pour construire le moteur d'acquisition et de notoriété de Solteo. Premier recrutement marketing de l'entreprise, tu pars d'une page presque blanche : stratégie, canaux, budget et marque sont à construire, en lien direct avec Manon (CEO).

Ton objectif : générer un flux régulier de leads qualifiés pour l'équipe commerciale, à un coût d'acquisition maîtrisé, et faire de Solteo une référence de l'électrification des bâtiments auprès des installateurs. Tu accompagneras aussi le lancement de nos nouvelles offres.

Missions et responsabilités

1. Acquisition & génération de leads

  • Construire et piloter les campagnes d'acquisition multicanales (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads)

  • Structurer la BDD et lancer des campagnes d'outreach (Lemlist, Instantly). Créer des workflows de nurturing dans HubSpot, en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale et les SDR.

  • Optimiser en continu le CPA, le ROAS et le coût d'acquisition client.

2. SEO, GEO & contenu

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie SEO, ainsi que notre visibilité dans les réponses des moteurs IA (GEO).

  • Créer des contenus qui positionnent Solteo comme un acteur incontournable de la transition énergétique : articles, livres blancs, webinars, témoignages clients.

  • Concevoir les supports aux commerciaux et à la communication auprès de nos clients.

3. Marque, positionnement & go-to-market

  • Faire rayonner la marque : identité visuelle, réseaux sociaux (en pilotant notre agence), événements et salons de la filière.

  • Accompagner les lancements produitet développer le co-marketing avec nos partenaires distributeurs et fabricants.

  • Explorer de nouveaux leviers : partenariats, relations presse, parrainage.

4. Data & pilotage

  • Mettre en place un tracking fiable jusqu'au CRM, et des dashboards clairs (GA4, Search Console, HubSpot).

  • Suivre les métriques clés (CAC, LTV, taux de conversion) pour décider quelles actions accélérer ou arrêter.

  • Faire évoluer nos automatisations (Make, Zapier) et nos agents IA, déjà bien développés, pour démultiplier ton impact.

Tes objectifs:

⭐ 0 à 1 mois
T'imprégner de l'écosystème Solteo, auditer nos canaux d'acquisition et prendre en main notre stack (CRM, automatisations, Ads) pour lancer tes premières campagnes.
🎯 Objectif : maîtrise des outils et premiers leads qualifiés

⭐ 1 mois à 1 an
Piloter une stratégie d'acquisition multicanale rentable, alignée avec l'équipe commerciale, et doubler le trafic organique grâce au SEO.
🎯 Objectif : autonomie complète et accélération de l'acquisition

⭐ Au-delà d'un an
Identifier de nouveaux leviers de croissance et construire ton équipe marketing.
🎯 Objectif : leadership stratégique et management d'équipe

Les compétences qu’on recherche

  • Expérience : 4 à 7 ans en marketing, dont une première expérience en SaaS B2B, idéalement en start-up ou scale-up.

  • Polyvalence 360° : tu as touché à la lead gen, au SEA/SEO/GEO, au contenu et à l'automatisation, et tu sais faire toi-même autant que piloter des prestataires.

  • Culture ROI & data : tu aimes les chiffres, les reportings, et tu sais quand tuer une campagne non rentable. Tu es très autonome, dynamique et proactif(ve).

  • Créativité & audace : tu as l'œil pour le design, une plume qui convertit, et l'envie de tester des idées qui sortent de l’ordinaire.

  • Leadership : tu sais porter une vision, défendre tes idées et challenger l'existant avec des arguments.

  • Langues : Français et Anglais parfaitement bilingues/fluents.

Ce qui serait un plus

  • Une expérience dans la Construction Tech ou l'Energy Tech, ou auprès des artisans et du bâtiment.

  • Une réelle motivation pour les projets à impact et la transition énergétique.

Mais Solteo c’est aussi…

  • Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée.

  • La chance de parfaire et d'enrichir tes connaissances dans un secteur en pleine croissance et qui a du sens.

  • Des bureaux situés en plein centre de Paris, avec plusieurs autres start-ups du solaire

  • Une diversité de projets captivants, offrant l'opportunité de collaborer avec des clients diverses et variés. Pas possible de s’ennuyer !

Nous te promettons aussi une ambiance d’équipe bienveillante, accueillante et stimulante. Et bien sûr, plein d’évènements d’équipe !

 

Processus de recrutement

  • 📞 Entretien avec un recruteur en visio (30 min) : pour discuter de ton CV et des attentes sur le poste avec Mélanie (Talent Acquisition)

  • 🤝 Entretien de fit en visio (45 min) : pour faire connaissance, discuter de ton parcours et de tes motivations avec Manon (CEO).

  • 🎯 Entretien technique (1h) : mise en situation pratique sur un business case.

  • 🕵️‍♂️ Prise de références

  • 🍽️ Déjeuner d’équipe : rencontre conviviale avec les fondateurs et toute l'équipe Solteo.

 

Détails du poste

  • CDI - temps Plein

  • Paris 17e

  • Prise de poste: dès que possible

  • Rémunération : selon expérience

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About the Role We're hiring a Senior Payroll and Benefits Specialist to own payroll processing and compliance for our workforce across the US and Europe. You will be the main contact between the company and our US EOR provider and international payroll advisors (UK, US, Poland, Portugal, Estonia, Germany). For European entities that run payroll locally, you will receive their payroll data, keep one accurate record of who sits on which entity's books, and consolidate it into group-level reporting. You will also own benefits administration, the annual renewal cycle, and pensions in every country where we operate. The job covers more than processing. You will run live payroll cycles accurately and also improve how payroll works: writing SOPs, tightening controls, consolidating reporting, managing providers, and supporting audits. Over time you will reduce our reliance on third-party providers by moving payroll onto our in-house platform in each country where we hold a local entity, including setting up payroll for a separate US entity on its own system ahead of a planned handover to local ownership. You will work closely with People, Finance, payroll providers, benefits brokers, pension providers, and auditors, and you will be the person employees go to for fast, accurate answers on pay, pension, and benefits. The role is UK-based. Responsibilities Run UK and US payroll cycles from start to finish: validate all inputs (new hires, leavers, salary changes, bonuses, commissions, time off), review every payroll register, and coordinate with the US EOR and international payroll advisors. Act as the main contact for European entities that run their own payroll: receive monthly payroll data, reconcile it against HRIS headcount, and keep a single accurate record of who sits on which entity's books. Own statutory filings and tax portal access for UK and US payroll, and produce consolidated group payroll reporting to support month-end close, accruals, reconciliations, and audit. Administer benefits and pension schemes in every country: enrollments, changes, leaver removals, entity transfers, reconciliations to payroll and provider invoices, and the annual renewal cycle with brokers and providers. Move payroll onto our in-house platform in each country where we hold a local entity, covering statutory registration, data migration, parallel running, and cutover. Set up and run payroll for a separate US entity on its own system ahead of a planned handover to local ownership. Build and maintain the payroll operating rhythm (calendars, SOPs, controls, knowledge-base materials) with regular audits across payroll, HRIS, benefits, and provider data. Hold external providers and country contacts to agreed timescales, and resolve discrepancies before they reach an employee's pay. Answer employee questions on pay, pension, and benefits quickly, accurately, and confidentially, against a published response standard. Requirements Must-have: Direct coordination of EOR providers, payroll advisors, or local payroll contacts across multiple countries. You hold providers to deadlines, check their outputs, and consolidate data into a reliable group view. You have owned UK payroll cycles from start to finish, have credible US payroll exposure (direct processing, EOR coordination, or advisor management), and have reconciled payroll against HRIS or entity data across several countries. Benefits and pensions administration experience, including enrollments, leavers, provider invoices, payroll deductions, UK auto-enrollment, member data, and annual renewals. Payroll migration or entity setup experience: you have supported or led a move from an external provider or EOR to in-house processing (statutory registration, data migration, parallel running, cutover, provider exit), or set up payroll for a new entity. You have built payroll systems, processes, controls, calendars, and documentation from scratch or in a very immature environment, and can turn compliance requirements into workflows that hold up under live payroll deadlines. Experience producing payroll reporting for Finance and supporting close, accruals, reconciliations, and audit, with strong documentation and control discipline. Strong vendor coordination: you hold external partners to timelines, challenge discrepancies, and escalate constructively across time zones and jurisdictions. Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and fluency across payroll, HRIS, benefits, and accounting systems, with close attention to data accuracy. Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience, in Accounting, Finance, HR, or a related field. Proficiency in English required. Nice-to-have: Experience with commission and bonus calculations. Experience running a payroll migration from an external provider to in-house processing yourself. Experience in high-growth, multi-entity, multi-country environments.   • Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

  • Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

  • Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

  • Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

  • Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

  • Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

Requirements

  • Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

  • Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

  • Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

  • A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

  • Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

  • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

  • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

  • Open-source firmware contributions.

  • Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

raw.title: Electrical Engineer
raw.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Electrical Engineer, you will own that hardware end to end, from sensor choice and PCB to firmware, so that the data reaching our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and integrate the hardware that captures the data our models learn from: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

  • Own the firmware and embedded-software layer: real-time data collection, multi-sensor sync, calibration, and time-stamping.

  • Spec and select sensors and compute for new hardware projects, balancing physical constraints against downstream ML needs.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your hardware delivers their training data, and bad sensor choices haunt them for months.

  • Prototype fast: bench builds, custom rigs, breadboard to working device in days, not quarters.

Requirements

  • Up to 5 years building production-grade hardware or IoT systems.

  • Strong embedded-software skills: C/C++, RTOS, and microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

  • Experience integrating sensors: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

  • A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: electrode placement, sample rate, filtering, noise floor, and motion artifacts. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.

  • Comfortable with PCB design and hardware debugging (logic analyzer, oscilloscope), with at least one foot in firmware.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

  • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

  • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

  • Open-source firmware or hardware contributions.

  • Experience scaling from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, vendor management, and certification.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

Fluency with AI-assisted workflows, leveraging modern tools to improve productivity and quality while critically evaluating their outputs and limitations. description: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. Who You Are You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls. You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things. You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding. You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom. Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said. You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity. You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results. You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack. Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive. Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are. A Plus If You Have Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role. Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps. Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client. Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report. An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment. How We Work Together You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer. Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice: Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask. Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt. Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked. The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on. The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you. This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once. Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too. You will work alongside experienced threat hunters, incident responders, and detection engineers in a collaborative team that values sharp analytical thinking over checkbox compliance.

This team is building toward an AI-augmented operating model. You will be expected to use AI-driven tools in your daily work and to contribute to how we integrate these capabilities into our detection, triage, and response workflows. What You’ll Do

Alert Triage & Monitoring 

  • Monitor and triage security alerts across SIEM, EDR, and CSPM platforms covering both corporate and product environments.
  • Investigate alerts to determine scope, severity, and whether escalation is warranted.
  • Leverage AI-assisted triage and enrichment tools to accelerate analysis and reduce mean time to detect.
  • Classify, document, and track alerts through the full lifecycle using ticketing and case management systems.

Incident Response & Investigation 

  • Participate in or lead incident response engagements from detection through remediation, including evidence collection, forensic analysis, root cause determination, and stakeholder communication.
  • Conduct investigations across SIEM, EDR, CSPM, and cloud-native log sources including identity provider logs, cloud audit trails, and network flow data—spanning both corporate and product infrastructure.
  • Execute established IR runbooks across identity, endpoint, cloud, and email investigation workflows.
  • Manage or assist with evidence handling, forensic artifact collection, and chain-of-custody procedures.
  • Produce clear, decision-ready incident summaries and post-incident reports for both technical and leadership audiences.

Detection Engineering & Threat Intelligence 

  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and tuning of detection rules across SIEM and EDR platforms, with a focus on reducing false positives and closing coverage gaps.
  • Translate threat intelligence (CVE advisories, CISA alerts, vendor bulletins, open-source feeds) into actionable detection content, with particular attention to threats targeting privileged access tooling and supply chain attack vectors.
  • Help maintain and evolve detection coverage mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Partner with threat hunting peers to validate detection logic through hypothesis-driven hunts.

AI Integration & Automation 

  • Use AI-driven tools for alert triage, enrichment, and investigation as a standard part of daily operations.
  • Contribute to the evaluation, integration, and optimization of AI and automation capabilities across the team’s workflows.
  • Assist in designing prompts, agent workflows, or LLM-based pipelines that augment analyst capabilities and reduce manual effort.
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve log ingestion, data quality, and tool integrations.

Operational Excellence 

  • Maintain daily operational notes and shift handoff documentation.
  • Contribute to and refine IR runbooks, playbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours incident escalation.
  • Track and report on operational metrics (MTTD, MTTR, MTTC, false positive rate) and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Participate in tabletop exercises, purple team activities, and post-incident reviews. 

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in a SOC, security operations, or incident response role.
  • Understanding of common attack frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK), network protocols, and endpoint behavior.
  • Experience with at least one SIEM platform and familiarity with writing search or detection queries.
  • Familiarity with EDR platforms and cloud environments (IaaS preferred).
  • Comfort using AI systems (e.g., LLM-based assistants, copilots, or AI-driven analysis tools) as part of security workflows.
  • Strong written communication skills; able to document findings clearly and concisely for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with identity and access management platforms and cloud security posture management tools.
  • Scripting and automation skills (Python, PowerShell, or equivalent) applied to security workflows.
  • Familiarity with SOAR platforms or orchestration tools for automated response and enrichment.
  • Experience designing or implementing AI agent architectures, LLM-based automation pipelines, or prompt engineering for security use cases.
  • Experience building or contributing to threat intelligence programs or detection-as-code pipelines.
  • Understanding of the privileged access management landscape and the threat actors that target it.
  • Track record of evaluating and adopting emerging technologies in a production security environment.

What We Offer

  • 25 days’ holiday which increases with length of service
  • Competitive pension scheme
  • Three weeks' additional leave at seven years' service
  • Fully remote in the UK with up to 4 weeks per year under our Working Abroad policy (subject to approval)
  • Bupa Private Healthcare for you and family
  • Medicash Benefit (including opticians and dental cover)

  • Paid parental leave and enhanced maternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to co-invest and become a BeyondTrust shareholder
  • Investment in AI skills, with Claude Code and Copilot centres of excellence
  • Pluralsight and LinkedIn Learning licenses

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. Extensive experience creating and exposing OData v2/v4 services via SAP Gateway (SEGW) or RAP business services for UI consumption and third-party cloud integrations. Practical experience developing custom SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications or configuring Fiori Elements apps using CDS annotations. Firm understanding of modern SAP extensibility frameworks, including On-Stack Developer Extensibility (Embedded ABAP / Steampunk) and Side-by-Side Extensibility using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). Proven ability to trace, profile, and optimize ABAP/HANA execution using Runtime Analysis (SAT), ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC), SQL Trace (ST05), and SQL Monitor (SQLM). Perform automated code checks (ATC), enforce clean code standards, conduct peer code reviews, and optimize legacy custom code for S/4HANA compatibility. title: Security Software Engineer, IAM
description: Headquarters: Remote - United States About Vercel: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. About the Role: Traditional IAM teams operate as an approval queue: a request comes in, someone reviews it, grants it, and (hopefully) remembers to revoke it. Access reviews become quarterly spreadsheet exercises, audit evidence is assembled by hand, and the central team becomes the bottleneck for every decision. That model doesn't scale past a certain point, and Vercel is past it. Adding more approvers doesn't close the gap. Building the system that makes access self-serve, time-bound, and provable does. This role is about building that system. Identity at Vercel should work like the rest of our infrastructure: defined as code, reviewed in pull requests, deployed through CI, and observable in production. You'll own that transformation end to end: migrating Okta and all related IAM configuration fully behind Terraform, and building the self-serve access platform (including just-in-time access) that lets team and system owners define, request, and time-bound their own access instead of routing every decision through a central team. Provisioning, deprovisioning, and access reviews become workflows the system runs, with the audit evidence for SOC 2 and similar generated as a byproduct rather than a manual scramble. You'll also own the harder connective work: corporate IAM (employee identity, SaaS access, devices) and production IAM (service accounts, infrastructure permissions, on-call and prod access) usually live in separate silos with separate tools and separate evidence trails. You'll build them as one identity plane. And identity itself is changing shape. As agents increasingly act on behalf of users and systems, the old model of "one human, one identity" doesn't hold, and there's real debate about how to solve it: carry the human's identity through every hop the agent makes, or give the agent its own scoped identity that never impersonates the user. We don't have a fixed answer yet. We want someone who wants to be in the room helping us decide and then build it. Because of this, we're optimizing for someone who wants to build identity infrastructure as software, not administer identity products. A software engineer who's gone deep on identity, or an IAM engineer with a strong engineering background, is exactly who we're looking for. You'll work closely with Security Leadership, located remotely within the United States. If you're based within commuting distance of our SF or NY offices, the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. What You Will Do: Own the full IAM strategy for corporate, production, and product environments end to end, and own the bridge between corp IAM and product/prod IAM rather than treating them as separate problems Migrate Okta and all related IAM configuration to Terraform , so every identity change is reviewed, tested, and versioned like the rest of our infrastructure, driving infrastructure-as-code adoption and leveling up engineering teams in its use Build self-serve access governance tooling, including JIT (just-in-time) access: design and ship the framework that lets team and system owners define, request, and time-bound their own access, rather than security being a bottleneck for every request Own provisioning, deprovisioning, and access review workflows , built so the evidence trail generates itself and internal and external audits (SOC 2 and similar) are fast, not a manual scramble Work closely with the Accounts team , the engineers who build IAM into Vercel's own product (team and project roles, enterprise SSO, SCIM, API tokens), and find where that world and ours should connect Design and enforce least-privilege access controls across cloud, SaaS, and production infrastructure, partnering with platform and engineering teams to embed IAM early in design rather than bolting it on after Help define what identity and access should look like as agents , not just people, request and hold access at Vercel, and build the first versions of it About You: 7+ years of experience in identity, access management, or platform security engineering Experience building internal tools or self-service platforms , not just administering existing ones. You'd rather build the framework that lets other teams manage their own access than be the sole approver for every request Proficient in a production language like TypeScript/Node.js, Go, or Python, comfortable designing and consuming REST APIs, and able to ship and operate reliable services. The access platform you'll build is a production system, not a configuration Proficient in Terraform and committed to managing IAM infrastructure as code, ideally with experience migrating existing systems into it Hands-on with identity protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, SCIM) at the implementation level, not just configuration, including the failure modes: token replay, deprovisioned users retaining access, sync drift between identity providers and downstream systems Experience designing IAM at scale across both corporate (Okta or equivalent: SSO, MFA, lifecycle management, API-driven automation) and production (AWS or GCP IAM: service accounts, roles, workload identity federation) environments A systems thinker who defaults to "why does this class of access request exist" and "how does this scale to the next thousand employees and ten thousand agents," not just resolving the request in front of you Strong collaborator who can drive alignment across Engineering, IT, Compliance, and Security teams Comfortable operating with autonomy and owning decisions in a fast-moving environment Bonus If You Have Have led a Terraform migration for IAM or identity infrastructure at scale. Have designed or built JIT access systems or an access governance/request platform at a previous company. Have built or managed MDM/MAM tooling (Jamf, Intune, or equivalent) and device-trust integrations with identity. Understand how Vercel's own products handle IAM (team and project roles, enterprise SSO, API tokens) and are excited to partner with the Accounts team to bring internal and product-facing identity closer together. Have a point of view on agent identity (delegation, scoped credentials, impersonation boundaries) and want to help invent the architecture rather than apply an existing playbook. Have experience at a developer tools, infrastructure, or SaaS company. Hold certifications such as Okta Certified Professional/Administrator, AWS Security Specialty, or CISSP.
